name: War Machine

abilityDetails.Armor Up: Zırh değerini artırarak alınan fiziksel hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Pre-Fight: Dövüş başlamadan önce Pre-Fight ekranından değiştirilebilen yetenek.
abilityDetails.Suppression: Muharebe Güç Oranını belirtilen güçte azaltır.
abilityDetails.Armor Break: Düşmanın zırh korumasını kırarak hasar alımını artırır.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.

signatureAbility:
Empty The Clip
War Machine activates his Empty the Clip routine to do the following:
Gain 12 Fury Passives, each granting [448.78 - 1,590.13] Attack Rating. These effects are lost as War Machine lands attacks.
Gain 12 Regeneration Passives, each recovering [1,537.73 - 5,448.46] Health over 15 seconds. These effects are lost as War Machine is struck.

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: Start the fight with an indefinite Armor Up Buff increasing Armor Rating by [4,682.43].

abilitySections.title: Persistent Charge - Max 5
content: War Machine begins each Quest with 2 Persistent Charges.
Charges can be spent in the pre-fight screen to activate one or more Armory Boosts (found below). Each Boost lasts 1 fight, doesn't stack, and can be used by other Tech Champions.
Winning a fight with War Machine grants 1 Charge(s) plus an additional 1 Charge(s) for each other #Hero Champion on this team.

abilitySections.title: Armory Boosts - Pre-Fight Ability
content: Tech Attackers gain +10% Attack Rating when an Armory Boost is active.
Support: Gain 2 Cleanse Charges. When champions with Cleanse are inflicted with a Debuff, it is immediately Purified and a Cleanse Charge is removed.
Fortify: Gain Energy Resistance equal to their Armor Rating.
Skirmish: Gain up to +[1,196.76] Attack Rating based on current Armor Rating and Debuffs excluding Stuns gain +20% Duration.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: Refreshes all personal Debuffs excluding Stuns on the opponent. Cooldown: 20 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attacks
content: Advanced auto-targeting prevents the opponents from using Evade.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: The minigun's suppressing fire grants each shot a 100% chance to inflict a Suppression Debuff, reducting Combat Power Rate by 10% for 10 seconds. This effect applies on Blocked hits. Max Stacks: 5.
Each shot has a 60% chance to inflict a Rupture Debuff, each dealing [5,983.8] Physical Damage over 5.5 seconds. The chance to Rupture increases by 60% for each Armor Break Debuff on the opponent.
Each Suppression Debuff inflicted also Invalidates 1 Prowess effect from the Opponent.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: 100% chance to inflict an Armor Break Debuff, removing an Armor Up Buff and reducing Armor Rating by [4,125] for 30 seconds. Max Stacks: 2.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: 100% chance to inflict a Stun Debuff lasting 3.5 seconds.
Gain a Fury Passive increasing Attack Rating by [5,485.15] for 30 seconds. Each Armor break on the Opponent will grant War Machine an additional Fury Passive.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Empty The Clip
content: War Machine activates his Empty the Clip routine to do the following:
Gain 12 Fury Passives, each granting [448.78 - 1,590.13] Attack Rating. These effects are lost as War Machine lands attacks.
Gain 12 Regeneration Passives, each recovering [1,537.73 - 5,448.46] Health over 15 seconds. These effects are lost as War Machine is struck.
